[attribute-notes-type]
=== `@notes-type` Type of Publishing Notes

Type of notes that are contained in the <<element-notes,`<notes>`>> element. This element is inherited from JATS and is used for publishing notes, not for normative notes, non-normative notes, or metadata notes.

#### Usage/Remarks
This attribute is used for publishing notes like “`note-in-proof`”. In NISO STS, the type of a normative note, non-normative note, or metadata note is recorded in the attribute <<attribute-content-type,`@content-type`>>, for example, “`superseding`” note.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-notes,`<notes>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| The type of publishing note.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
